newsitem.title: GERMANY: SOCCER-TRAPATTONI SAYS HE WON'T REPLACE SACCHI.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-TRAPATTONI SAYS HE WON'T REPLACE SACCHI.

text.p: Bayern Munich trainer Giovanni Trappatoni said on Monday he had no intention of replacing Italy coach Arrigo Sacchi who resigned on Sunday night to return to AC Milan.
Trappatoni said moving to Italy was not an issue at all. "I have only one interest, and that is Bayern Munich."
"It is always the same. The Italians always come up with such stories," Trappatoni said referring to Italian media speculation that he might replace Sacchi.
Trappatoni has been Italian soccer's most successful league coach, winning the championship seven times, six of them with Juventus.
He failed on his last outing in Italy, leaving Cagliari during last season, but has since taken Bayern back to the top of the German Bundesliga in his second stint there.
Bayern manager Uli Hoeness said Trappatoni's contract ran until June 30, 1998. "He is, and will remain, our coach," he said.
